========================================
Unscoped enum with an underlying type
========================================

enum : unsigned short {A=2};

---

(translation_unit
  (enum_specifier
    underlying_type: (sized_type_specifier)
    body: (enumerator_list
      (enumerator name: (identifier) value: (number_literal)))))

========================================
Named enum with a sized underlying type
========================================

enum E : unsigned short {B=2};

---

(translation_unit
  (enum_specifier
    name: (type_identifier)
    underlying_type: (sized_type_specifier)
    body: (enumerator_list
      (enumerator name: (identifier) value: (number_literal)))))

========================================
Named enum with a primitive underlying type still parses
========================================

enum E : int {C=1};

---

(translation_unit
  (enum_specifier
    name: (type_identifier)
    underlying_type: (primitive_type)
    body: (enumerator_list
      (enumerator name: (identifier) value: (number_literal)))))

========================================
Unnamed bitfields
========================================

struct S{unsigned:0; int x;};

---

(translation_unit
  (struct_specifier
    name: (type_identifier)
    body: (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        type: (sized_type_specifier)
        (bitfield_clause (number_literal)))
      (field_declaration
        type: (primitive_type)
        declarator: (field_identifier)))))

========================================
Mixed named and unnamed bitfields in one declaration
========================================

struct T{int a:3, :4, b:2;};

---

(translation_unit
  (struct_specifier
    name: (type_identifier)
    body: (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        type: (primitive_type)
        declarator: (field_identifier)
        (bitfield_clause (number_literal))
        (bitfield_clause (number_literal))
        declarator: (field_identifier)
        (bitfield_clause (number_literal))))))
